ib.note: Credit for IB exams scoring 4+ (HL or SL); full diploma 30+ gives sophomore standing and a $3,000 renewable scholarship; 24 points qualifies for pathway program

ap.details: Credit by score: Calculus AB 3 = MTH 251 (4 credits), 4-5 = MTH 251+252 (8 credits); Calculus BC 3 = MTH 251+252 (8 credits), 4-5 = MTH 251-253 (12 credits); AP English Language 3+ satisfies English requirement
ap.note: Credit table is for Fall 2024 entry

22740.tests: Test-optional; SAT/ACT not required and only supplemental. SAT EBRW 560 or ACT English 21 can waive English test

math_test.name: Schoolhouse.world pre-calculus certification
math_test.details: Alternative to high school pre-calculus for direct admission to Engineering; ALEKS placement does not affect admission

22740.a_level: IGCSE O or A-level English grade C or better accepted for English requirement; IGCSE route needs 5 subjects (incl. maths, English, science) averaging 3.0 on NCAA scale
22740.prerequisite_maths: Pre-calculus or calculus with C- or better for direct entry to engineering (otherwise admitted to Exploratory Studies and guaranteed engineering after MTH 112Z with C or better); 3 years high school maths, 3 years science
